In PBP years US clubs typically run fewer 1200ks; candidates to check on rusa.org include Cascade 1200/1400 (Seattle International Randonneurs), Colorado High Country 1200 (Rocky Mountain Cycling Club), Endless Mountains 1240 (PA Randonneurs), Big Wild Ride 1200 (Alaska), Texas Rando Stampede 1200 and Taste of Carolina 1200. Gold Rush Randonnee (Davis Bike Club) runs on a 4-year cycle and is not expected in 2027.
